[ASSISTANT_SAID] Establishing a feedback mechanism during the session can help gather on-the-spot comments and suggestions.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Planning well in advance allows organizers to incorporate feedback and suggestions from previous sessions.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Demonstrating responsiveness to feedback can improve the event's reputation and attract more participants in the future.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Asking for feedback on proposed changes can ensure effectiveness before implementation.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Experienced reviewers can assist in identifying relevant feedback and filtering out irrelevant comments.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Feedback from non-experts can provide unique perspectives and insights that experts might miss.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Both expert and non-expert feedback can be valuable in identifying areas for improvement.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Organizers should establish a clear methodology for collecting feedback to ensure its relevance.
